name: Pan-Fried Thai Red Curry Cod with Carrot, Avocado & Cashew Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place curry paste, oil, soy sauce, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, red
toasted sesame oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Drizzle with half of the spice paste, then turn to coat the fish. (Reserve bowl with remaining spice paste for the salad.)
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
½ English cucumber
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into the bowl with the remaining spice paste. Add honey and stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl, along with the carrots, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup cashews, roasted unsalted
½ (283 g) bag shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cod and salad between plates. Enjoy!
